about: How a weakness in the proving-ground scenario catalogue (S01 to S09) maps to a sense point: which kind of sensor would see it (its modes, in the node library's own mode names) and where it sits in the twin (a node, or an edge between two nodes). Used only by scripts/measure_sense_points.py and its test. Product code and rules never read this file and never name a scenario.

mode_words.about: How the catalogue's own words for the sensor become node library modes. A weakness is seen when a suggestion carries any mode listed for it.

twin_matching: A place is named by its node library type (the part before the @) and one or more names. A node matches when its type is that type and its name is one of the names, or ends with a dash or a slash followed by one of them (the imported twin names things as the cloud does, for example the receipts bucket by its full name and a log group by its path).
next_to: A suggestion is on a weakness when it is on a node of its place. It is next to it when its node and a node of the place are consecutive steps of one attack path that the analysis found (either order). An edge place has two nodes.

crown_jewels.about: What a person tells WhiteHats matters in the shop (the same five the Where to watch browser journey marks): the two tables, the receipts bucket and the two secrets. Without marks the analysis has no target and suggests nothing.
